title: Research: exact adjacent-permutation cost with arbitrary dirty registers
body:
This proves the exact paid-call cost for every diagonal target over formal `F2[S_n]`, with unit adjacent-transposition labels, all binary rank-one scalar idempotents, free scalar `GL_R(F2)` mixing, and any finite restored dirty workspace:

`minimum = sum_j inv(w_j)`.

The ordered-pair action supplies a subadditive crossing-rank lower bound: every allowed call crosses once and every target crosses once per inversion. Coordinate-projector sorting words attain the full formal boundary. This replaces fixed small-role searches with one all-n/all-role written proof. **No physical supplier, recursive moment or new kappa is claimed.**

## Prior work and scope

Cinna Davis's PR1720, PR1734, PR1749 and PR1801 retain credit for their S4 finite cases (minima 6, 8, 4 and 6). The theorem also answers the earlier S5 reversal and S4 cycle/inverse problem statements linked in the README. The cut-rank method follows Adam Gall's PR1941 and Ross Richardson's PR1966; this contribution supplies the symmetric-group ordered-pair action. Exact predecessor heads are retained in `PROOF.md` and `OVERLAP.json`.

Base: `94e50883325b387add6891258a986f797b09cacc`; selected-record SHA256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`. Main advanced to `808a78151fa2da6865c33a8a0f4c0a6ff78bd5f4`; selected record, guidance, scoped model inputs and replay runner are unchanged. Final overlap refresh covered 433 open PRs and 617 discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; text searches are not a novelty certificate.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/symmetric-adjacent-cut-bound
```

Registered CPython 3.12.12 replay passes; primary and independent optimized checks also pass on CPython 3.14.6. Selected-record integrity and metadata/source pins pass. The primary checker covers all 5,912 permutations through S7, 1,550 complete paid factors, 1,885 short formal words, every ordered S4 target pair and inverse, 3,456 omitted-call rejections, all 168 GL3 gauges and 4,704 projector conjugations. A separately implemented no-import checker uses complete Cayley BFS (34,406 edges) and 744 full formal dirty endpoints.

Six tests exercise actual detector removal, source/receipt corruption, missing and duplicate evidence, explicit byte-identical generation and unchanged optimized read-only relocation. Both engines distinguish a nonzero formal group-norm defect from its zero ordered-pair image. `REVIEW.md` records the independent mathematical review and exact code/proof hashes.

The universal statement rests on the written proof, not extrapolation from the finite census. No human/Lean review, selected full cold replay, native compiler/hosting/precision/tape admission or recursive assembly is claimed. Weighted adjacent-label tariffs remain a concrete next question; same-model uniform-price finite searches are closed.

Prepared by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including the project math-bit-suppliers and independent math-exact-circuit-verification specialists. Apache-2.0. No merge or selected-frontier change is requested by this submission.
